study.title: Purepu supraglacial-lake drainage, Rasuwa (8 July 2025)
study.question: Are usable Sentinel-2 observations available before and after 8 July 2025 over the Purepu lake source area, and what does cloud cover permit?
limitations: Monsoon cloud; terrain shadow; approximate AOI centre.
No volume or dam-failure inference from area alone.

aoi.boundary_source: Placed from published NDRRMA situation-report context; centre is approximate and has not been snapped to a verified lake shoreline.

can_conclude: Which optical observations exist before and after the 8 July 2025 event, at what validity, and where the observation gaps are.
Candidate snow/ice and surface-water index changes between April 2025 (before the monsoon) and October 2025 (after the monsoon) under an explicit seasonal caveat.
cannot_conclude: Discharged water volume, flood depth or discharge: lake surface area is not discharged-water volume.
The causal mechanism, or any casualty/damage claim from satellite differencing.
A clean immediate before/after pair: the only usable post-event July observation is the same-day pass at 63.2% validity.
interpretation.note: Feasibility verdict PARTIAL (docs/M4_FEASIBILITY.md): presented as evidence under constraint.

attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2020-2026), processed by ESA; L2A products distributed by the Element 84 Earth Search STAC catalogue (AWS Open Data). DEM: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (ESA/DLR) where included. Event context: NDRRMA (2025) and ICIMOD (2026) situation reporting, cited as external literature, not project measurements.

area_cross_check.method: projected polygon area, independent geodesic area on the WGS84 ellipsoid, and rasterised pixel-count area on the analysis grid
area_cross_check.note: the raster area differs from the polygon area by boundary rasterisation only; hectares and km2 are converted from projected square metres, not from degrees

limitations: Monsoon cloud; terrain shadow; approximate AOI centre.
No volume or dam-failure inference from area alone.
The following indices use 20 m SWIR bands resampled to the 10 m analysis grid and contain no genuine 10 m SWIR detail: ndsi.
Composites are robust within-period summaries of a few observations, not a dense time series; inter-annual change is represented by two period composites only.
Index differences are candidate spectral signals. They are not verified deforestation, wetland loss, construction, glacier damage or any other causal land-cover label.
Cloud, shadow and saturated-pixel exclusion relies on the provider SCL product; terrain shadow is not independently re-derived.
Surface reflectance is the provider L2A product; no independent atmospheric correction is performed.
Areas are planimetric on the documented projected grid; UTM scale distortion at this AOI is small but nonzero.
